_doc: Runtime config for the X bot. One post/day, pillar rotates by UTC weekday (see `rotation`; run.ts maps today's weekday to a slot, or takes --slot explicitly). Budget guard tracks spend against the prepaid X credit balance.

budget._note: balanceCents is cumulative lifetime funding, not a resettable pool: remaining = balanceCents - state.creditsSpentCents (which never resets). History: 500 (launch) -> 586 on 2026-08-06 (confirmed $0.86 left at X, creditsSpentCents pinned at 500 since exhausted 2026-07-20) -> 1086 same day after a further $5.00 top-up at X ($5.86 now available). To top up again: balanceCents += (new cents funded at X). FIRST-REPLY STRATEGY (Aug 2026): every post is now a 2-tweet sequence — main tweet (image+caption, no URL, billed at centsPerPostNoLink) + first reply (site link with UTM, billed at centsPerPostWithLink). Total cost per post = 22c. External links in the main tweet are penalised 30-80% by X's algorithm; putting the link in the first reply avoids this while still giving it impressions from thread expanders. linkThresholdPct removed — link always goes in the reply. Plan: burn remaining ~$5.68 at 5 posts/day testing this pattern, then migrate to OpenTweet.

slots._note: Saturday-only weekly roundup thread (3 tweets, 40-60% more impressions than standalone). weekday=6 means it only fires on Saturday even in '*' rotation mode.

_rotationDoc: Index = UTC weekday (0=Sun..6=Sat, JS Date#getUTCDay). null = scheduled day off. '*' = all slots post today (one per cron invocation, first unposted wins). A single slot id = legacy one-per-day mode. Currently Mon-Sat all-slots for first-reply A/B testing; Sunday quiet.
_dailyUtcHourDoc: 0 UTC = ~8pm ET, picked for US retail/crypto-native evening scroll time (also catches early Asian trading-day open). Not yet verified against this account's own engagement data — X's Owned Reads pricing (GET /2/users/{id}/tweets, $0.001/resource) now makes it cheap to pull real post history and confirm/adjust this once there's enough post volume to compare.
_slotCatchupHoursDoc: Set to 23 for all-slots-daily mode so late-firing crons still pick up missed slots. Was 6 when only one slot posted per day.
